notes.title: ALPHA CENTAURI has been updated
notes.content:
Update details:


Changelog Ver 82.33009

Gameplay


 The Aegis A-1 S spacecraft (S) weapon can now be triggered at 50%.
 The Bat Mk-2 supportive projectiles won’t be disabled when triggering (S) weapon.
 The Emperatriz X-46 fire rate now is slightly faster, also weapon (B) now can fire multiple missiles, and its weapon (S) is automatic.
 Turrets now can be destroyed in one strike.
 The number of obstacles in some mission were reduced.
 Crosshair for single missiles was amplified. 
 Switching inputs in Settings is not longer needed. Now player can switch at runtime.


UI

[olist]
 General user interface was improved
 Font was increased
[/olist]

Graphics


 Pickups in the Operation Anti-Squadrons have more definition.
 Post process in the Virtual Lab is now retro.

notes.title: Changelog Ver 81: 161
notes.content:
Greetings alpha centauri pilots!

In this updates There've been some modifications to the Main Menu, Pause Menu, and General Settings.

-Demo Button: samples available where input and movements are associated graphically mainly for non english speakers, or for quick learning.

-Preferences: general settings with new options, including analog sensitivity; more scalability options for reducing system performance cost; key bindings, and other gameplay preferences.

-Pause Menu: All from above, now you can make adjustments during gameplay and avoid returning Main Menu to do so.

In game store Full  Gamepad Support has been changed for Partial Gamepad support

This only affects the settings option, you can use the gamepad to play full game.

IMPORTANT:

Please if you have a low spec system, try to low some scalability settings to experience a fluid and smooth gameplay experience. Try to maintain FPS at least above 50 units. To enable Steam FPS go to Steam > Settings > In-Game > search for In- Game Fps counter

IMPORTANTE:

Por favor si posee un computador con los requisitos mínimos para este juego. prueba bajar la calidad de algunas opciones gráficas para experimentar un modo de juego más fluido. Intenta mantener los FPS al menos por encima de 50 unidades. Para habilitar los FPS en pantalla ve a
Steam > Settings > In-Game > search for In- Game Fps counter

Your feedback is very important.

If you have any suggestion, or a bug to report, do not hesitate to leave your comment or open a new thread on community Hub, I’ll be attentive.

Please take a moment to leave your review to keep supporting me.

Thank you very much.

notes.title: Out Of Early Access
notes.content:
Greetings alpha centauri pilots!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38240413/a61a892bab1d43086289a11644bc6b9268cf0e11.png

I'm happy to announce that the Full Release of ALPHA CENTAURI SPACE FORCE has come. Thank you for supporting this project during this 9 months of Early Access.

Full Release Main Features:
    
 Play four unique operations in different scenarios.
     Drive different spacecraft with unique tech.
     The Spacecraft are designed for the less and the most experienced pilots.
     Switch between direct fire, or lock-on system.
     Overtime auto-upgrade system.
     The SE shield prevents spacecraft from instant destruction.
     Male and female pilot voices to choose from.
     A displayable npc assistant officer will guide you along missions.
     Rank and score system based on honor points, medals, ranks and emblems.
     Fight against intense enemies.
     Bonus: retro like endless space shooter mini game.
     Fast-moving electronic music that keeps the energy and the pace up.
     Full controller support.

Check the forum for more details about the patch and updates notes.

PD: Early Access is over, but I'll be listening to your feedback and ideas. If you have ideas for new game features, improvements, or you just want to share your excitement, please let me know on the Steam Community.

notes.title: New Content: retro like 80s arcade space shooter game
notes.content:
Hello centauri pilots!

In this new update you'll have the chance to enjoy a retro 80s like arcade space shooter game, but this game mode incorporates today's technology nevertheless; also power-ups have been implemented that will help pilots to overcome the alien threat during this new challenging space battle experience. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38240413/0381ce09c2a2efa00e391570ec59ebf222c8fe45.png

A retro 80s like arcade space shooter game included in the base game

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38240413/b3a43783bbaf410c04f4450d5a1e3a7bc88a1c69.png

Anti-Squadrons Operation

Gameplay:

The player controls a spacecraft that moves horizontally at the bottom of the screen, firing upward.  Wave enemies appear on the screen above the player's ship, shooting at it and periodically diving towards it in an attempt to crash into it. The spacecraft is equipped with a shield  at 100% However it depletes as it gets hit. Enemies can drop pickups which player spacecraft can be upgraded with. Eventually the player may encounter captured ally spacecraft which will reward the player if is rescued unharmed.

Features:
   
  5  rounds including alien boss.
     Pickups  upgrades + score bonus
     Regenerative shield
     Endless fun


Each level has five separate rounds. The player must complete a round to advance to the next. 


Endless waves of different squadron formations + boss per rounds

Eliminate several squadrons formations, and take down the boss to gain a new round.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38240413/09b0a04145e23fed721b59f309af86435a801abc.png


Additional Achivements

Unlock 2 new achievements:
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38240413/c13efa1a2295db0e4ee3cb0db854d19e195572e2.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38240413/9da57d0aa89c65777e7256a4bb17bdb7cb3e9201.png


Update Summary 

 Added a new game mode: arcade retro space shooter
 Added new operation: Anti-Squadron Operation
 Gamepad icon  is marked in control options
 Shock shield visual effects was improved
 Added 2 new achievements
 Fix an issue where spacecraft stucks when combining control axis


PD:

If you have any suggestions, anything you always ever wished this retro game had, please use the community forum and I'll see what I can do. Do it before ALPHA CENTAURI SPACE FORCE leave Early Acess.

Have a retro endless fun!

notes.title: New Space Battle Experience
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38240413/6f11b2364691aecf307954035a60e4e9158db63d.png


New Content

Operation Spyware

CYEBB is looting the resources of the planet Proxima b disproportionately. ALPHA CENTAURI SPACE FORCE is deploying the best strike units for a flash assault. Qualified pilots are required for the execution of the Operation Spyware which consist of entering the enemy station to allow us to intercept its database, as well as track their movements. Unfortunately we do not have further information about this space station. Pilots must use their initiative and keep a close eye on the information from the official assistant assigned, who eventually will update the objectives of the operation.


New Game Mode

Vertically Scrolling Shooter

Are you thirsty for more Shoot 'Em Up? Try out now a new space battle experience.



Modifications

-Penalty Score was decreased, now pilots can have more continues.

-The space background was changed, now it looks deeper.

Another Operation is coming soon and will be available in the base game.

Stay tuned and have fun!
